title: Read the home feed on LinkedIn's redesigned React feed
task: List the posts currently rendered in the home feed (author, text, age) without relying on class names.

steps.note: Posts are role=listitem under data-testid=mainFeed. Do not use class names: they are hashed per build.
The feed scrolls inside an inner <main>, not the window.

caveats: The old selectors (feed-shared-update-v2, data-urn=urn:li:activity) return nothing on the redesigned feed.
Class names are hashed per build; use data-testid and ARIA roles.
The post composer is an obfuscated React link that automation cannot reliably open. Do not spend time on it.
author: jeet-dhandha
